beats.text: India leads the planet with the poorest fifth holding 11.1% of national income.
Colombia has the lowest on Earth, where the bottom fifth takes 3.2%.
India has 3.5 times the income share that Colombia sees.
The USA stands at 5.1%, while Brazil drops to 3.9%.
Belarus hits 10.3% and Slovenia hits 10%, keeping the bottom fifth well above Latin America.
What share goes to the poorest in your nation?
